A Texas Tech Health Sciences Center study found that midlife cardiorespiratory fitness is a strong predictor of healthy aging. This research supports the value proposition of fitness facilities and training programs that focus on cardiovascular health for middle-aged adults. The findings could be useful for TeamBuildr OS clients when marketing their services to the 40+ demographic.
